case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's beachfront location, sea views, cleanliness and recent renovation, with many citing friendly staff, good breakfast, pool/jacuzzi and rooftop bar; parking and proximity to restaurants were also noted. Negative comments included noise (loud ocean at night, late café music), humidity, bright exterior lighting, occasional room maintenance issues (overloaded socket, broken blind, missing jacuzzi slippers), and a charge for safe use; some reviewers reported no dislikes.
